notes: *together* is given to ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό rather than read as the συν- preverb of συνήχθησαν: rule 106 is scoped to a particle no Greek preposition stands to answer to, and one stands here, so rule 94 decides the pair. Reading *together* as the preverb and leaving ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό without an English word is the competing analysis.
The intervening article τό is its own unrepresented unit, a noncompositional unit never absorbing one (rule 93).
